content:
lina_cs: Heads-up — BlueOrbit renewal in ~6 weeks. Finance flagged a 30% QoQ increase in inference spend, mostly from peak batch jobs.
ashwin_se: Onboarding recap: heavy batch semantic search + chat sessions. Current model pinned: big-llama-70b-v2. They regenerate a lot; no prefix KV cache enabled yet.
priya_solutions: Proposal: quick, low-risk optimizations before renewal. 1) PTQ int8 on search model. 2) Swap non-critical chat paths to a 13B-optimized variant. 3) Smart routing to cheaper dedicated pool for long-horizon/low-priority queries. Also enable prefix caching.
sam_runtime: Runtime telemetry agrees. ~60% tokens from search pipeline; quality difference for 13B is negligible for most search intents. I can run a 5%->25% canary and gather cost/quality deltas.
perf-bot: deploy-check: canary slot available on dedicated pool 'eu-cost-2' — 2x A40 GPUs idle.
lina_cs: Priya: can you draft the customer-facing note with savings estimates and potential latency/quality impacts so we can tie acceptance to renewal discussion?
priya_solutions: Draft one-pager ready. Key points:
- Recommendations:
  1) PTQ int8 for search model — estimated -40 to -50% token cost for search pipeline.
  2) Swap non-critical chat flows to 13B-optimized variant — estimated -25 to -35% for chat tokens.
  3) Smart routing: send queries >512 tokens to 'eu-cost-2' during defined windows and route low-priority traffic to dedicated pools.
  4) Enable prefix KV caching for session retention — reduces duplicate token generation.
- Conservative projection: current $42,000/month -> $28,000 (conservative -33%). Best-case with all changes: ~$23k.
- Rollback / acceptance criteria: fail if reranking NDCG drops >1% or 95th p90 latency increases >150ms.

ashwin_se: Add an enablement session for the customer to run their eval prompts through our private eval harness. Also note: PTQ requires a 2-hour calibration pass on a representative sample — we can host a presigned S3 job.
sam_runtime: Routing policy + canary snippet I'm proposing to share with them:

```yaml
routing_policy:
  - match: "query_len > 512 and intent == 'batch_search'"
    target: "dedicated:eu-cost-2"
    percent: 100
  - match: "priority == 'high'"
    target: "hosted:low-latency"
    percent: 100
canary:
  model_variant_swap: 5% -> 25% over 48h
  metrics: [cost_delta, ndcg, latency_p95]
  fallback_on_threshold: true
```

perf-bot: deploy-plan: canary created by sam_runtime at 1749802234.
priya_solutions: Scheduling: I'll book a 30-min enablement call (recorded) to walk them through validation checklist + calibration steps. Also will ask Sales for a short-term Dedicated commit discount to sweeten renewal.
lina_cs: Action items:
- Priya: send the customer note + schedule enablement (today).
- Sam: start canary and post 24h cost + quality diffs in this thread.
- Ashwin: prepare PTQ calibration instructions and S3 presign flow.
- Lina: loop in AE for renewal conversation and attach the one-pager to renewal docs.

sam_runtime: Canary started. Will post initial 12h diff tomorrow AM.
perf-bot: monitoring: canary -> health OK, no increased error rate.
priya_solutions: Sending note to BlueOrbit now. Will include conservative savings table and explicit rollback criteria. :thumbsup:
